vocabulary.meaning: To tell someone what another person said

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी को बताना कि किसी और ने क्या कहा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 他の人が言ったことを伝える

examples.sentence: She reported that he was late.

translation.Hindi: उसने बताया कि वह देर से आया था।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は彼が遅れたと報告した。

vocabulary.meaning: A verb like 'say', 'tell', 'ask' used in reported speech

meaning_translation.Hindi: ऐसी क्रिया जैसे 'say', 'tell', 'ask' जो रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में प्रयोग होती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 伝達話法で使われる “say” “tell” “ask” などの動詞

translation.Hindi: उसने कहा कि वह थका हुआ था।
translation.Japanese: 彼は疲れていると言った。

vocabulary.meaning: Changing verb tense when moving from direct to reported speech

meaning_translation.Hindi: प्रत्यक्ष से अप्रत्यक्ष वाक्य में बदलते समय क्रिया के काल को बदलना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 直接話法から間接話法に変えるときに動詞の時制を変えること

examples.sentence: Direct: 'I am hungry.' Reported: He said he was hungry.

translation.Hindi: प्रत्यक्ष: 'I am hungry.' अप्रत्यक्ष: उसने कहा कि वह भूखा था।
translation.Japanese: 直接: 'I am hungry.' 間接: 彼はお腹が空いていると言った。

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक वाक्य जो जानकारी देता है

examples.sentence: He said that he liked pizza.

translation.Hindi: उसने कहा कि उसे पिज़्ज़ा पसंद है।
translation.Japanese: 彼はピザが好きだと言った。

vocabulary.meaning: A sentence used to ask for information

meaning_translation.Hindi: जानकारी माँगने के लिए प्रयोग किया गया वाक्य
meaning_translation.Japanese: 情報を求めるための文

examples.sentence: She asked if I was coming.

translation.Hindi: उसने पूछा कि क्या मैं आ रहा हूँ।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は私が来るかどうか尋ねた。

vocabulary.meaning: A question that can be answered with 'yes' or 'no'

meaning_translation.Hindi: ऐसा प्रश्न जिसका उत्तर 'हाँ' या 'नहीं' हो सकता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: はい/いいえで答えられる質問

examples.sentence: He asked if I liked coffee.

translation.Hindi: उसने पूछा कि क्या मुझे कॉफी पसंद है।
translation.Japanese: 彼は私がコーヒーが好きかどうか尋ねた。

vocabulary.meaning: A question starting with who, what, when, where, why, how

meaning_translation.Hindi: ऐसा प्रश्न जो who, what, when, where, why, how से शुरू होता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: who, what, when, where, why, how で始まる質問

translation.Hindi: उसने पूछा कि मैं कहाँ रहता हूँ।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は私がどこに住んでいるか尋ねた。

vocabulary.meaning: The clause used to report a statement

meaning_translation.Hindi: कथन को रिपोर्ट करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाने वाला उपवाक्य
meaning_translation.Japanese: 陳述を伝えるために使う節

examples.sentence: He said that he was tired.

translation.Hindi: उसने कहा कि वह थका हुआ था।
translation.Japanese: 彼は疲れていると言った。

vocabulary.meaning: The rise and fall of the voice; in reported speech, the meaning is conveyed without intonation changes

meaning_translation.Hindi: आवाज़ का उठना और गिरना; रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में अर्थ बिना स्वर परिवर्तन के व्यक्त किया जाता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 声の上げ下げ。間接話法ではイントネーションの変化なしで意味が伝わる

examples.sentence: Direct: 'Are you okay?' Reported: She asked if I was okay.

translation.Hindi: प्रत्यक्ष: 'क्या तुम ठीक हो?' अप्रत्यक्ष: उसने पूछा कि क्या मैं ठीक था।
translation.Japanese: 直接: 'Are you okay?' 間接: 彼女は私が大丈夫か尋ねた。

vocabulary.meaning: The way reported speech can make questions more polite

meaning_translation.Hindi: जिस प्रकार रिपोर्टेड स्पीच प्रश्नों को अधिक शिष्ट बना सकती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 間接話法が質問をより丁寧にする方法

examples.sentence: She asked if I could help her. (more polite than 'Can you help me?')

translation.Hindi: उसने पूछा कि क्या मैं उसकी मदद कर सकता हूँ। ('Can you help me?' से अधिक शिष्ट)
translation.Japanese: 彼女は私に手伝えるか尋ねた。（'Can you help me?' より丁寧）

grammar_tips.title: Backshift in Reported Speech
grammar_tips.explanation: Present tense in direct speech usually changes to past in reported speech. Example: 'I am tired' → He said he was tired.

explanation_translation.Hindi: प्रत्यक्ष भाषण में वर्तमान काल अक्सर अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में भूतकाल बन जाता है। उदाहरण: 'I am tired' → He said he was tired.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 直接話法の現在形は間接話法で過去形になることが多い。例：'I am tired' → He said he was tired.

grammar_tips.title: Reporting Statements
grammar_tips.explanation: Use a reporting verb (say, tell) + that-clause. Example: She said that she liked music.

explanation_translation.Hindi: रिपोर्टिंग क्रिया (say, tell) + that-उपवाक्य का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: She said that she liked music.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 伝達動詞（say, tell）＋that節を使う。例：She said that she liked music.

grammar_tips.title: Reporting Yes/No Questions
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'asked if/whether' + clause. Example: He asked if I wanted coffee.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'asked if/whether' + उपवाक्य का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: He asked if I wanted coffee.
explanation_translation.Japanese: “asked if/whether”＋節を使う。例：He asked if I wanted coffee.

grammar_tips.title: Reporting Wh-Questions
grammar_tips.explanation: Keep the wh-word and use statement word order. Example: She asked where I lived.

explanation_translation.Hindi: wh-शब्द बनाए रखें और कथन शब्द क्रम का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: She asked where I lived.
explanation_translation.Japanese: wh語を残して陳述文の語順を使う。例：She asked where I lived.

grammar_tips.title: No Backshift for General Truths
grammar_tips.explanation: When reporting general truths, keep the tense the same. Example: He said the earth is round.

explanation_translation.Hindi: सार्वभौमिक सत्यों को रिपोर्ट करते समय काल नहीं बदलें। उदाहरण: He said the earth is round.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 普遍的真実を伝えるときは時制を変えない。例：He said the earth is round.

vocabulary.question: Which verb is commonly used to report statements?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सी क्रिया कथनों को रिपोर्ट करने के लिए सामान्य रूप से उपयोग की जाती है?
question_translation.Japanese: 陳述を伝えるのによく使われる動詞はどれですか？

question_translation.Hindi: उसने कहा कि वह ___ थका हुआ था।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼は疲れていると___。

vocabulary.question: In reported speech, 'I am happy' becomes 'He said he was happy'.

question_translation.Hindi: रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में, 'I am happy' 'He said he was happy' बन जाता है।
question_translation.Japanese: 間接話法では、'I am happy' は 'He said he was happy' になる。

vocabulary.question: Which phrase is used to report yes/no questions?

question_translation.Hindi: हाँ/नहीं प्रश्नों को रिपोर्ट करने के लिए कौन सा वाक्यांश उपयोग किया जाता है?
question_translation.Japanese: はい・いいえ疑問文を伝えるのに使う表現はどれですか？

question_translation.Hindi: उसने पूछा कि मैं कहाँ ___ रह रहा हूँ।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼女は私がどこに___住んでいるか尋ねた。

sentence.question: Arrange: [he, said, music, liked, that, she]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [he, said, music, liked, that, she]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [he, said, music, liked, that, she]

sentence.question: She asked me if I ___ coffee.

question_translation.Hindi: उसने मुझसे पूछा कि क्या मुझे ___ कॉफी पसंद है।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼女は私にコーヒーが好きかどうか___。

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा सही रिपोर्टेड स्पीच है?
question_translation.Japanese: 正しい間接話法はどれですか？

sentence.question: He asked me where I ___ going.

question_translation.Hindi: उसने मुझसे पूछा कि मैं कहाँ ___ जा रहा था।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼は私にどこへ___行くのか尋ねた。

sentence.question: Arrange: [asked, me, she, was, if, fine, I]

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [asked, me, she, was, if, fine, I]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [asked, me, she, was, if, fine, I]

listening.question: What did the speaker report?
listening.audio_text: She said that she was busy.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता ने क्या बताया?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を伝えましたか？

question_translation.Hindi: रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में हमेशा 'that' की आवश्यकता होती है।
question_translation.Japanese: 間接話法では必ず 'that' が必要である。

listening.question: How was the yes/no question reported?
listening.audio_text: He asked if I liked football.

question_translation.Hindi: हाँ/नहीं प्रश्न को कैसे रिपोर्ट किया गया?
question_translation.Japanese: はい・いいえの質問はどのように伝えられましたか？

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सी जानकारी रिपोर्ट की गई?
question_translation.Japanese: どんな情報が伝えられましたか？

listening.question: General truths change tense in reported speech.
listening.audio_text: He said the sun rises in the east.

question_translation.Hindi: सार्वभौमिक सत्य रिपोर्टेड स्पीच में काल बदलते हैं।
question_translation.Japanese: 普遍的な真実は間接話法で時制が変わる。

speaking.question: Say: 'He said that he was tired.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'He said that he was tired.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'He said that he was tired.'

speaking.answer: he said that he was tired

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'She asked if I was fine.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'She asked if I was fine.'

speaking.answer: she asked if i was fine

speaking.question: Say: 'He said that he liked music.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'He said that he liked music.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'He said that he liked music.'

speaking.answer: he said that he liked music

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'She asked where I lived.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'She asked where I lived.'

speaking.question: Say: 'He asked if I wanted coffee.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'He asked if I wanted coffee.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'He asked if I wanted coffee.'

speaking.answer: he asked if i wanted coffee
